pr.title: feat(conport): expose search_content via MCP surface
pr.body:
Adds a `search_content(workspace_id, query)` FastMCP tool to server.py and conport_mcp_stdio.py, proxying the existing `GET /api/search/{ws}?q=...` REST handler. Registers JSON-RPC dispatch_map entry and _get_tool_schemas entry in enhanced_server.py.

Depends on DMX-CONPORT-OPTIMAL-102 (500 bugs in search_content route must be fixed before this can be verified end-to-end).

Acceptance: search_content MCP call returns results for a known keyword seeded in the test workspace.

steps.task: Preflight worktree. Read server.py and conport_mcp_stdio.py for existing tool registration patterns. Read enhanced_server.py search_content handler and dispatch_map to understand the integration seam. Confirm 102 fix is present (ag_catalog gone, UUID/Decimal stringified).
validation: search_content REST handler located in enhanced_server.py and documented in proof.
102 bugfixes confirmed present (grep for ag_catalog returns zero matches, UUID/Decimal str() calls present).
Existing tool registration pattern documented for consistency.

steps.task: Add search_content FastMCP tool to server.py and conport_mcp_stdio.py. Tool accepts workspace_id (str) and query (str) and proxies GET /api/search/{workspace_id}?q={query} via aiohttp.
validation: search_content function present in server.py with correct decorator.
Matching proxy function present in conport_mcp_stdio.py.
No search logic duplicated — tool delegates entirely to REST handler.
